entries.notes: Supports creating Proxy instances via new Proxy(target, handler) with object target/handler validation. Currently implemented traps are get, set, has, getOwnPropertyDescriptor, defineProperty, deleteProperty, ownKeys, getPrototypeOf, setPrototypeOf, isExtensible, preventExtensions, apply, and construct, each with fallback-to-target behavior when the trap is absent. The defineProperty and deleteProperty operations validate target configurability, writability, and extensibility invariants, preserve abrupt completions, and forward recursively through nested Proxy targets when a trap is null or undefined. Proxy intentionally remains a non-JsObject exotic representation: its own-property operations dispatch through descriptor traps or target forwarding rather than JsObject shape/slot fast paths. Full ECMAScript Proxy coverage remains limited to the documented and tested behavior; cross-realm trap cases are not yet covered.

Proxy.revocable(target, handler) validates object target/handler values, returns { proxy, revoke }, and makes the currently implemented proxy operations (get, set, has, getOwnPropertyDescriptor, defineProperty, deleteProperty, ownKeys, getPrototypeOf, setPrototypeOf, isExtensible, preventExtensions, apply, and construct) throw TypeError once revoked.
